research_conclusion: Cost-robustness of short-horizon momentum on the collected 10-asset universe is classified COST_ROBUST at lookbacks 3/5/10 (canonical 5) under the repo's existing realistic cost model (commission_per_trade=2.0, commission_per_share=0.003, slippage_cents=2.0, slippage_proportional=0.0005) and a 2x stress, judged by the candidate-minus-null gap and corroborated by essentially unchanged absolute net-of-cost medians (drag ~1e-4/fold). The a-priori COST_MARGINAL/COST_FRAGILE prediction was refuted. Qualification: conditional on constant-dollar fixed-notional sizing; the matched coin-flip null pays more costs than the persistent signal, so part of the gap-widening is a null-turnover effect; JNJ/XOM are noise-level members of the edge set. This is a research/simulation finding, not a traded result.
